The '''Ranged Lock''' was a remote control seal designed to secure the entry hatch of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. Manufactured by [[VargeCorp/Legends|VargeCorp]], the system cost one thousand, two hundred and fifty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="PSG" />
